page: Google Cloud Platform c3-highmem-176 is a memory-dense server instance powered by the 4th Generation Intel Xeon Platinum 8481C processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, the system provides 88 physical cores across 176 dedicated threads at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz, accompanied by 105 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory provisioning reaches 1408 GB of RAM, sustaining an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction extensions include AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), delivering hardware-level acceleration for matrix and vector computations without discrete GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-threaded computational capabilities alongside massive memory throughput. The instance delivers 146,417.7 in multi-core stress-ng tests and achieves a PassMark CPU score of 104,670.37, placing it in the top decile of evaluated platforms. Memory subsystems achieve 446.56 GB/sec in large-block uncached sequential reads and 195.8 GB/sec in writes. This high memory throughput supports substantial in-memory transaction loads, evidenced by Redis throughput exceeding 164 million operations per second and web serving performance reaching 122.92 GB/sec.

Cost efficiency is driven by high per-node resource density, which allows organizations to consolidate large distributed footprints into a single virtual environment. However, single-core processing metrics remain in the middle tier, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1,723.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1,623.18. Furthermore, the server includes no local NVMe storage and no bundled public IPv4 networking, requiring remote persistent disks for secondary storage and data persistence.

Google Cloud Platform c3-highmem-176 is primarily engineered for large-scale, memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Optimal deployment profiles include enterprise in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, massive Redis caching layers, high-throughput analytics pipelines, and heavily parallelized ETL batch processing jobs.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3-highmem-176 is an x86_64 cloud server featuring 176 dedicated vCPUs from 88 physical cores of an Intel Xeon Platinum 8481C processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. Outfitted with 1408 GB of RAM, it maintains an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside 105 MB of L3 cache and hardware support for Intel AMX and AVX-512 extensions. The server yields top-tier multi-threaded compute and throughput metrics, demonstrated by 446.56 GB/sec uncached memory read bandwidth, over 164 million Redis operations per second, and a PassMark CPU score of 104,670.37. Single-threaded metrics remain average, and the instance provisions neither local storage nor discrete GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage. This hardware profile is engineered specifically for large-scale enterprise in-memory databases, large Redis clusters, high-concurrency caching tiers, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
